# Display snippets for docs/yaml.md

--8<-- [start:read_sig]
read(+YamlString, -Data)
--8<-- [end:read_sig]

--8<-- [start:read_all_sig]
read_all(+YamlString, -DocList)
--8<-- [end:read_all_sig]

--8<-- [start:read_file_sig]
read_file(+Path, -Data)
--8<-- [end:read_file_sig]

--8<-- [start:write_sig]
write(+Data, -YamlString)
--8<-- [end:write_sig]

--8<-- [start:write_all_sig]
write_all(+DocList, -YamlString)
--8<-- [end:write_all_sig]

--8<-- [start:write_file_sig]
write_file(+Path, +Data)
--8<-- [end:write_file_sig]

--8<-- [start:get_sig]
get(+Data, +Path, -Value)
--8<-- [end:get_sig]

--8<-- [start:parse_config]
-import_from(yaml, [read_file, get])

db_config(PATH, HOST, PORT, NAME) <- (
    read_file(PATH, CFG),
    get(CFG, ["database", "host"], HOST),
    get(CFG, ["database", "port"], PORT),
    get(CFG, ["database", "name"], NAME)
)
--8<-- [end:parse_config]

--8<-- [start:round_trip]
-import_from(yaml, [read, write, get])

round_trip(YAML, KEY, VAL) <- (
    read(YAML, D),
    write(D, S),
    read(S, D2),
    get(D2, KEY, VAL)
)
--8<-- [end:round_trip]

--8<-- [start:k8s_manifests]
-import_from(yaml, [read_all, get])

service_names(YAML, NAMES) <- (
    read_all(YAML, DOCS),
    maplist([D, N] >> get(D, ["metadata", "name"], N), DOCS, NAMES)
)
--8<-- [end:k8s_manifests]

--8<-- [start:python_interop]
-import_from(yaml, [read])

all_keys(YAML, KEYS) <- (
    read(YAML, D),
    KEYS is ++(list(D.keys()))
)
--8<-- [end:python_interop]
